prompt_instructions: Attach the original image as the primary reference for the exact offer hierarchy and product placement.
Keep all visible text exactly as 'MUA COMBO' and 'NHẬN X2 QUÀ TẶNG'.
Do not convert this into a lifestyle scene; it must remain a bold text-led promotional graphic.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square retail promotion poster for a BADASS combo offer. Use a bright yellow background with a black BADASS wordmark centered at the top. Add a tilted glossy blue label reading 'MUA COMBO' near the upper left. In the middle, place giant stacked blue typography with thick white outline reading 'NHẬN X2 QUÀ TẶNG'. Behind the upper-right part of the text, draw a thin blue gift-box outline with a ribbon bow. Along the bottom, place product cutouts: black boxer briefs and a blue brief on the left, a white T-shirt in the center, and a light gray polo on the right. Add a cropped blue angular shape in the bottom-left corner. Technical style: graphic retail promotion poster with product cutouts, bright flat commercial lighting, crisp edges, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, low resolution, incorrect Vietnamese text, weak contrast, cluttered layout, distorted products, extra props, flat lifeless colors, watermark, signature
